initial_receipt.explanation: The execution is faulty because the top-level corpus includes qualifying record n06-r01 with demand_score 9, but Job 1 output omits it from both needs and evidence_sources. The captured select_demand function would select records with demand_score >= 3, so n06-r01 should have been retained. Job 2 then preserves the incomplete upstream handoffs, so the root fault is upstream.
